title: Coefficient-independent open external-product diagrams, swap and triple compatibility
statement: Let $j:X\hookrightarrow\bar X$ and $k:Y\hookrightarrow\bar Y$ be open immersions of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $T,\bar T$ be schemes. Define a two-factor open external-product diagram to consist of schemes $S,S'$, maps $\bar p:\bar T\to\bar X$, $\bar q:\bar T\to\bar Y$, $p:T\to X$, $q:T\to Y$, $u:T\to\bar T$, $r:S\to X$, $s:S\to\bar Y$, $j_1:S\to\bar T$, $k_1:T\to S$, $r':S'\to\bar X$, $s':S'\to Y$, $k_2:S'\to\bar T$ and $j_2:T\to S'$. Require $j_1,k_1,k_2,j_2,u$ to be open immersions; require the four squares $(r,j_1;j,\bar p)$, $(q,k_1;k,s)$, $(s',k_2;k,\bar q)$ and $(p,j_2;j,r')$ to be Cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product]. Here $(a,b;c,d)$ means the square $c\circ a=d\circ b$. Require $\bar qj_1=s$, $rk_1=p$, $\bar pk_2=r'$, $s'j_2=q$, $j_1k_1=u=k_2j_2$, $\bar pu=jp$ and $\bar qu=kq$. No common base or outer product universal property is part of this record: when needed, these are imposed separately on $(p,q)$ and $(\bar p,\bar q)$. Define its swap on the same $T,\bar T$ by interchanging $X,Y$, $\bar X,\bar Y$, $S,S'$, $\bar p,\bar q$, $p,q$, $r,s'$, $s,r'$, $j_1,k_2$, and $k_1,j_2$, retaining $u$ and the corresponding equations. For a third open immersion $l:W\hookrightarrow\bar W$, let $d_{12},d_{23}$ be such diagrams and $d_L,d_R$ diagrams for $(u_{12},l)$ and $(j,u_{23})$ with the same total $T,\bar T$. Define the triple compatibility predicate by the six projection equations $\bar p_{12}\bar p_L=\bar p_R$, $\bar q_{12}\bar p_L=\bar p_{23}\bar q_R$, $\bar q_L=\bar q_{23}\bar q_R$, $p_{12}p_L=p_R$, $q_{12}p_L=p_{23}q_R$, $q_L=q_{23}q_R$, and $u_R=u_L$. These are coefficient-independent geometric data and equations, with no tensor comparison or theorem asserted.
